channel.title: The Dig — Calibration, tuning and drift
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Calibration, tuning and drift preset. Today’s ranked reading list covers three adjacent software-stack concerns rather than spin-qubit hardware itself: 2611.15080 offers a structure-aware equivalence-checking oracle for validating unitary circuit transformations, 2611.16285 reports multi-GPU orchestration for relay belief-propagation QEC decoding on an HPC system, and 2611.16971 presents a low-cost, hardware-agnostic zero-noise extrapolation wrapper for NISQ error mitigation.
